description: C'BUS is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes Châteaubriant Derval. Deux minibus électriques C’Bus permettent d’assurer à Châteaubriant des trajets réguliers et rapides sur 5 lignes reliant le centre-ville, les quartiers, les services publics majeurs (gare SNCF, Pôle de Santé de Choisel, cité scolaire Môquet-Lenoir…), la plus grande usine du territoire (Kuhn) et les zones commerciales. Coverage: Communauté de Communes Châteaubriant Derval. The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes Châteaubriant Derval. Its keywords include horaires-circuits. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-07-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
